description_en: Enables or disables the IPv6 security protection feature for a specified domain name configuration
description_zh: 开启或关闭指定域名配置的IPv6安全防护功能
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-domain-ipv6-status --instance-id waf-cn-mp91530000 --domain www.example.com --enabled 0 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDomainIpv6Status

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The domain name that has been added
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable IPv6 security protection. Valid values:

0: Disabled.

1: Enabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用IPv6安全防护，取值：

0：关闭

1：开启
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the WAF instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default resource group is used
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id
